updateMessage: Ultra-smooth startup performance on lower-end devices, progressive shelf rendering, instant catalog loading, and zero-stutter video player initialization.
changelog: Major performance boost for low-spec devices: 0ms cold start with progressive shelf rendering
Eliminated GPU/CPU bottlenecks on app launch by optimizing card rendering pipelines
Deferred background resource preloading to keep initial app entry fast and responsive
Zero-stutter video player launch: eliminated media decoder race conditions on startup
Enhanced local streaming proxy with 128KB dynamic buffer for instant streaming start
